method: Read on main: src/, src-tauri/src/, crates/. 'backend' = logic or a command exists and is tested, but no UI path reaches it.

sidebar.home-entry.why: The Home row in Sidebar.tsx selects Home, and PaletteHost.tsx handles nav.home (go-home) through the keybinding dispatcher.

sidebar.repo-groups.why: Repos from conductor.db (reposFromDb in src/state/persisted.ts) render as collapsible groups with nested workspace rows (Sidebar.tsx, toggleRepo); collapsed ids persist in UI prefs.

sidebar.repo-order.why: Repos drag to reorder in Sidebar.tsx (draggable rows, onDrop; order logic in src/state/repoOrder.ts, tested). The store calls the registered db_reorder_repos (sidebar_repo_commands.rs, #283), which writes repos.display_order, and db_list_repos reads it back in that order.

sidebar.repo-hide.why: The repo menu has Hide repository / Unhide repository, and the list ends with a Show hidden repositories toggle (Sidebar.tsx, visibleRepos). The store calls the registered db_set_repo_hidden (sidebar_repo_commands.rs, #283), which writes repos.hidden.

sidebar.repo-icon.why: #315 (0f82f19): RepoIcon (src/components/RepoIcon.tsx, rules in src/state/repoIcon.ts) replaces the initial in the sidebar repo header and follows Conductor's U9 order: emoji, stored image or bundled icon name, a favicon found in the repo, the GitHub owner's avatar, then the initial. Change icon (RepoIconDialog.tsx, from the repo menu or right-click) has Icons (Conductor's 238 names), Emoji, Favicon and Upload tabs, search and Reset. db_set_repo_icon (registered in lib.rs) writes repos.icon through openconductor_db::repos::set_icon; repo_favicon checks Conductor's 28 favicon paths in order. Known difference: the Emoji tab is a curated subset because REA could not extract Conductor's runtime-loaded emoji dataset (REA gap recorded in #315).

sidebar.add-repo.why: The My workspaces menu (HeaderMenu in Sidebar.tsx) runs openProject in App.tsx: folder picker, inspect_project_folder, add_repository, which now records the repo in conductor.db (on_repository_added).

sidebar.ws-name.why: #370 on 66a892a: workspaceLabel (src/components/sidebarLabel.ts, tested) follows Conductor's $V (renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js @2,153,907): a user-set name, then any stored workspace_name (reposFromDb maps workspaceName), then the PR title, then the branch prettified with the configured branch prefix stripped (useBranchPrefix; 'sven/dark-mode' -> 'Dark mode'), unless it equals intended_target_branch ?? 'main', else the directory name. Rename sets user_set_workspace_name (#315). The PR title now refreshes for every on-screen row through the 5-minute sidebar PR poll (sidebarPrPoll.ts), not only the open workspace.

sidebar.ws-branch.why: The row label is the prettified branch (workspaceLabel, unless it equals the target branch) and the tooltip shows the raw branch; since #337 the leading icon is the row status icon, which is the branch icon (Ready) for a workspace with a remote and no PR, as in the reference rows.

sidebar.ws-status.why: On 66a892a the row icon follows Conductor's chain: rowStatus({workspaceState: ws.state, session, pr: ws.pr}). #370 closed two gaps: the session status is now aggregated over every chat of the workspace (reasonChat chatStatuses -> workspaceSessionStatus, nTr order), and every on-screen row polls its PR every 5 minutes like Conductor's G5e (sidebarPrPoll.ts / sidebarPrPoller.ts, batched per repository), so PR states reach rows that are not open and come back after a restart once the row is on screen. Still missing: the chat queue's SessionStatus is only idle/working/cancelling/error, so needs_plan_response, needs_user_permission, needs_user_input and waiting never reach the icon.

sidebar.ws-diffstat.why: Each row shows +/- counts from the registered sidebar_workspace_changes (merge base with the target branch, committed and uncommitted, lockfiles skipped as in Conductor's FPt; useRowDiffStat.ts, sidebarDiffStat.ts), fetched for on-screen or active rows. Unselected rows are muted unless the colored_sidebar_diffs setting is on (styles.css data-colored-sidebar-diffs, AppearancePage.tsx).

sidebar.ws-unread.why: Row menu toggles unread (R), unread rows render semibold and opening a row clears it. Changes are now written through the registered db_set_workspace_unread (sidebarPersist.ts) and reposFromDb maps workspaces.unread back. There is still no jump-to-next-unread-workspace command.

sidebar.ws-pinned.why: Pin/unpin from the row menu or P, and a Pinned group above My workspaces (src/state/sidebarOrder.ts, SidebarSections.tsx). In the desktop app the store writes each change through the registered db_set_workspace_pinned (sidebarPersist.ts, sidebar_workspace_commands.rs), which sets workspaces.pinned_at; reposFromDb maps it back on reload.

sidebar.sections.why: #370 on 66a892a: the section header menu (Edit section, New section…, Delete section) and the sidebar's 'New section…' open SectionDialog (name + emoji); the row menu's Move to section ▸ lists every section, 'New section…' (creates one holding the workspace) and 'Remove from section'. The edits are pure functions after Conductor's index-chunk _Y/SY/wY/yY/kY/V2 (src/state/navigationSections.ts, tested), the projection follows renderApp usa (first section wins, archived and hidden-repo workspaces left out, newest first), and the whole layout is read and written through db_read_navigation_sections / db_write_navigation_sections (sidebar_section_commands.rs, registered in lib.rs) into conductor.db's navigation_sections tables with Conductor's tve updatedAt stamp. Not wired: reorderSection (bY) has no UI yet; that belongs with sidebar.drag-to-section.

sidebar.drag-to-section.why: #412 on 93e4881: useSidebarDrag.tsx (wired in Sidebar.tsx) is a pointer drag after Conductor's controller `esa` (renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js, elementFromPoint hit test at byte 10,091,139, re-checked in the decoded bundle): a press becomes a drag after 5 px; a workspace row drops onto a section, onto Pinned or onto My workspaces, and a drop that leaves it where it is is no target; a section header drags to reorder sections (reorderSection, Conductor's bY); Escape, blur and pointercancel abort, the click ending a drag is swallowed, and the list edge-scrolls 4-16 px a frame. Pinning unassigns the workspace from its section as Conductor's pin mutation does. Drops go through the store's section actions, which #370 persists to conductor.db's navigation_sections tables. Rows inside a section stay newest first, as in Conductor (usa), so there is no row order to drag. Pure drop rules tested in navigationSectionsDrag.test.ts; not exercised end to end in the desktop app by the verifier.

sidebar.ws-numbers.why: workspace.switchTo1..9 switch rows over sidebarOrder, and holding the switch modifier for 500 ms shows 1..9 in place of the first nine rows' icons (src/state/shortcutHint.ts, SidebarWorkspaceRow.tsx). The workspaces.number column is not shown and there is no setting to show numbers.

sidebar.ws-next-prev.why: workspace.next / workspace.previous handled in PaletteHost.tsx through stepWorkspace (wraps, sidebar order).

sidebar.search.why: The sidebar Search row opens the command palette (onSearch -> setPaletteOpen in App.tsx), which searches workspaces by name, branch and repo (src/palette/search/model.ts).

sidebar.rename.why: #315 (0f82f19): row menu Rename opens RenameWorkspaceDialog (Sidebar.tsx). It calls db_rename_workspace (sidebar_rename_commands.rs, registered in lib.rs), which follows Conductor's renameWorkspace (index-BGEQ8YjU.js @1,050,054): refuses an initializing workspace, a directory name another workspace of the repo uses and an invalid name; for a ready worktree it leaves the worktree in place, adds a sibling symlink recorded as secondary_directory_name and queues the old link in symlinks_pending_deletion; otherwise it rewrites directory_name and workspace_path. workspace_name and user_set_workspace_name = 1 are saved (workspace_rename.rs). The remembered Also rename branch checkbox renames the branch through rename_workspace_branch and sets user_set_branch_name (db_mark_user_set_branch_name). Not built: the CLI 'workspace rename' (no CLI in the rebuild).

sidebar.archive.why: #391 (274ac80) replaces the row-only db_archive_workspace with archive_workspace (src-tauri/src/workspace_archive/, flow.rs), which the row menu, WorkspaceView, the palette and archive on merge all reach through startArchive (store.ts). It follows Conductor's dYe/mYe (index-BGEQ8YjU.js @ ~966,478 / ~969,254): checkpoint conductor-archive-<id>, refuse in safe mode while a merge/rebase/cherry-pick/revert is in progress with the sticky warning and Archive retry (discardGitOperationState), archive commit = HEAD kept under refs/conductor-archive-heads/<id>, row state/branch/archive_commit, archive script, .context move, worktree removal and delete_branch_on_archive. #397 (aa32456) closes the last gap: the running-agents check folds every chat of the workspace (workspaceAgentStatus; working, cancelling or waiting block, as dYe), and every archive calls stopWorkspaceAgents, which stops each working or cancelling chat of the workspace (stopChat), as Conductor's Z$ (@974,859) calls cancelSession for every session of a local workspace. Conductor's cancel also settles a 'waiting' session (@3,013,752); no OpenConductor chat reports 'waiting', so there is nothing to settle. Read on f6c05d7 with the bundle (sha256 prefix b5b01f33); not run in the desktop app.

sidebar.archived-view.why: #391 (274ac80) replaces db_unarchive_workspace with unarchive_workspace (checkpoint, worktree, .context and branch restored, setup rerun), and restoreWorkspace runs it through startUnarchive. Only the archive-on-merge toast's Unarchive dispatches restoreWorkspace (useArchiveOnMerge.ts); there is still no archived-workspaces list. #397's title promises archived workspaces in the palette with Unarchive, and its first commit (753f691) had them (CommandPalette, PaletteHost, palette search model), but the merge onto #391's backend dropped them: the squash aa32456 touches only store.ts and src/workspace/archive*. On f6c05d7 the palette still filters archived workspaces out (search/model.ts), reposFromDb leaves archived rows out of state (persisted.ts HIDDEN_STATES), so Home's 'Only archived' filter is empty too, and a workspace archived from the row menu, WorkspaceView or the palette, or after the toast closes, cannot be restored from the UI.

sidebar.resize-toggle.why: The rail (useSidebarWidth, panelPrefs.tsx) has resized the left sidebar since #332, clamped to 192–480 and saved as left_panel_width; #423 (99edc40) brings it to Conductor's Nta (@ 9,970,616): primary-button drag previews without saving, release saves, a cancelled pointer reverts, double-click resets to 256 and saves, and the aside is capped at 40% of the window. Left toggles: top-bar button, ⌘B (view.toggleLeftSidebar) and the native View > Toggle Left Sidebar item; right: ⌥⌘B (view.toggleRightSidebar, right_panel_visible) and View > Toggle Right Sidebar (menu.rs emits toggle_left_sidebar / toggle_right_sidebar, App.tsx listens, as Conductor's lva/ova @ 10,931,680). REA gap: which submenu Conductor appends the two items to was not decompiled; they go in View here. Not run in the desktop app.

sidebar.footer-usage.why: #410 on 9930339: Settings › Experimental 'Show sidebar resource usage' (sidebar_resource_usage in conductor.db settings, default off, AppPrefRows.tsx) shows ResourceUsagePill in the sidebar's top bar beside back/forward, where Conductor mounts it (renderApp Isa/bna @9,942,220), despite the setting text saying footer. The pill hides under 200 px of sidebar and goes icon-only under 260 px, polls the registered get_resource_usage every 2 s, and opens the Resources popover (qta @9,933,654): include terminals, group by workspace, tree/flat, copy, CPU/Memory totals, sortable Name/CPU/Mem table, Show all past 7 rows. Inferred, not decompiled: which processes Conductor samples, its label rules and redaction (evidence/sidebar-resource-usage/NOTES.md).

sidebar.transparency.why: No vibrancy or transparency setting or window effect; the sidebar is a CSS color-mix fill (styles.css).

sidebar.ws-actions.why: #400 merged as be4f789 (squash of 6e038d3): the row menu reads Mark as unread/read (R), Pin/Unpin (P), Set status ▸, Move to section ▸ (#370), Rename (#315), Copy link (⌘⇧C) and Archive (WorkspaceActionsMenu.tsx). Copy link puts openconductor://workspace?id=<id> on the clipboard with the 'Copied link' / 'Failed to copy link' toasts (src/workspace/link.ts, Conductor's XV and $$); workspace.copyLink is bound to Cmd+Shift+C in keybindings/registry.ts. Out of this item: the copied link opens nothing until app.deep-link (unowned) handles openconductor:// URLs.

sidebar.empty-state.why: With no repos, Sidebar.tsx shows a muted one-line empty state under My workspaces (matches the REA empty-Home capture).

sidebar.add-menu.why: #423 (99edc40): the My workspaces header menu's 'Add project…' opens the add-repository popover on the next frame, and ⌥⌘A (nav.addRepository) opens it too, as Conductor's wra/yra do (renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js @ 10,069,794). SidebarAddRepositoryMenu (AddRepositoryMenu.tsx) shows Conductor's shared body Gji (@ 9,785,064): Open project, Open GitHub project, Quick start, then 'Recents' with a braille spinner row while loading. Recents come from recent_local_repos.rs, a Rust port of Conductor's MQo script (last 2,000 zsh history cd targets plus .git dirs up to 3 levels under the fixed roots, newest first, at most 8), leaving out folders already added (qQo); a Recents row adds that folder through the same checks as Open project. Pure parts are unit-tested (addRepositoryMenuModel.test.ts). Not run in the desktop app.

sidebar.visibility-settings.why: Re-read on 99edc40 (stale since #332, 7d2d4a2): left_panel_visible (default true), left_panel_width (default 256, clamped 192–480) and right_panel_visible are rows in conductor.db's settings table (src-tauri/src/app_prefs/), loaded and written by useSidebarVisiblePref / useSidebarWidth (panelPrefs.tsx), as Conductor does. The browser build, which has no database, falls back to defaults.

home.route.why: Since #322 the selection has a {kind: 'root'} entry for '/': the store starts there (startSelection, src/state/selectors.ts) unless a workspace was open, and removing or archiving the open workspace or its repository falls back to it, as Conductor's '/' (Wls) does. A start path of /all-workspaces opens the Home list, and #381 adds /first-run-onboarding before it (main.tsx FirstRunGate). There is no URL router: routes are selection kinds, which a window with no address bar does not expose.

home.org-states.why: Not applicable locally. REA (renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js, sha256 matches the asset manifest; evidence/screens/first-run-onboarding.md, #381): Wls (@2,118,579) returns null while so()/rl loads the signed-in user's organizations from Conductor's cloud API and redirects to /all-workspaces when fc(org) is 'cloud'. OpenConductor has no account and no organizations, so there is no organization load and no cloud organization; the local startup wait shows FirstRunGate's loader before Home, as Bxa does.

home.layout.why: HomeScreen.tsx: centred wordmark above three label-only cards in a 1-to-3 grid, drag region, fade-in; REA capture puts wordmark and cards at the reference positions (cards y 368-495). Differences: GitHub card cloud vs globe icon, Quick start sparkle vs folder-plus; the wordmark is our own brand by design.

home.sidebar-toggle.why: HomeScreen.tsx shows the toggle only while the sidebar is hidden, with tooltip and shortcut hint, offset past the traffic lights.

home.add-local.why: Open project card: native pickFolder, inspect_project_folder, add_repository (registered); default branch from the backend.

home.open-project-flow.why: decideOpenProject (src/state/openProject.ts) sends a folder with no .git or no origin to GitHubRepoDialog, whose registered github_repo_create (github_repo.rs) runs git init when needed and publishes; otherwise it adds with a file:// remote; errors in a toast. There is no non-GitHub setting (always behaves as off).

home.clone-github.why: CloneGitHubRepoDialog.tsx takes a URL and a location with a Browse picker and calls the registered clone_repository; progress streams over a Channel into a log and errors map through cloneErrorMessage (src/state/cloneDialog.ts); the clone is recorded in conductor.db.

home.new-project.why: Quick start (CreateProjectDialog.tsx -> create_new_project) runs git init with a first commit or create-next-app, creates the private GitHub repo, registers the project with add_repository, then since #350 creates the real first workspace through create_workspace and starts the repository's setup script (src/home/createFirstWorkspace.ts, tested in firstWorkspace.test.ts) and opens it under the backend repo id. As in Conductor's gbi (@2,103,713, evidence/screens/create-project.md) the GitHub step cannot be skipped. Not run end to end in the packaged app.

home.duplicate-repo.why: Clone now matches (#343): the Clone dialog result is added under its backend id and a second clone of an added remote becomes its own project in a <name>-v1 folder (sameRepoRecord, src/state/addRepo.ts, tested; naming::bump since #379), as Conductor's g2t/C2t do. Open project still differs: App.tsx openProject refuses an already-added folder with REPO_EXISTS (findExistingRepo), and add_repository returns the existing id for a known path, while Conductor inserts a second repos row for the same folder named <name>-v1 (evidence/screens/duplicate-repo.md).

home.no-repo-guard.why: With no repositories, CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx explains a repository is needed and offers an Add repository menu (Open project or Clone repo).

home.status-overview.why: #322 adds the Home list (AllWorkspaces.tsx, src/home/allWorkspaces.ts): grouped by last activity with counts, unread rows semibold, diff stat and a short relative time. The status column shows only 'working' (a spinner): our session status has only working/idle, so Conductor's other active statuses (needs plan response, needs permission, needs input, cancelling, waiting) never show, the same gap as sidebar.ws-status. The status-matrix toggle (internal_workspace_status_matrix, Settings > Experimental @10,701,242) and mine-vs-all (team organization sidebar, 'My workspaces' @10,055,740) are not built; #322 records them as cloud-only.

home.dashboard-routes.why: /all-workspaces is implemented by #322: the sidebar Home row, nav.home and the palette open AllWorkspaces, and a start path of /all-workspaces opens it. /dashboard is missing: REA (renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js, sha256 matches the asset manifest) shows route lta (@11,520,499) and a sidebar 'Dashboard' row (@10,029,038) shown when the dashboard_enabled setting is on (default 'false' in the index chunk's settings defaults); the rebuild has neither the route nor the setting.

home.recent.why: Re-read with REA (renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js, sha256 matches the asset manifest): 'Recent workspaces' is the command palette's All-tab heading with an empty query (m_a @10,909,908), not a Home list. Conductor keeps recentWorkspaceIds (most recent first, cap XOt = 5, recordViewedWorkspace) in its persisted UI store (partialize includes recentWorkspaceIds, index chunk @3,121,897), so the list survives a restart. Ours (src/palette/PaletteHost.tsx) shows the same heading and order but keeps up to 8 ids in React state only, so it is empty after a restart and holds 3 more than Conductor.

home.repo-search.why: #315 (0f82f19) mounts #354's Filter by project submenu (ProjectFilterSubmenu) in the My workspaces section header menu (Sidebar.tsx), and filterRepoGroups narrows the repo groups while Pinned keeps every repo's rows, as Conductor's pra/hBi do (renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js @10,019,058). The submenu renders nothing with one repository or none, offers All projects then each repository, and a stale filter is cleared once repos load. In the desktop app the choice is saved as conductor.db settings key sidebar_repo_filter (raw repository id; All projects deletes the row) through useAppPrefs/set_app_pref (src-tauri/src/app_prefs, openconductor_db::app_settings::keys::SIDEBAR_REPO_FILTER), matching Conductor's z6t updateSetting/deleteSetting (index-BGEQ8YjU.js @420,066, REA by sidebar builder 0c122c06). Only the browser build, which has no database, falls back to localStorage. The palette Projects tab (projectResults, Search projects...) was already built. Home and the Add-repository menu have no repo search, as in Conductor.

home.recents.why: CloneGitHubRepoDialog.tsx loads recent repos through the registered github_recent_repos (cached 2 min), shows three skeleton rows in a role=status region with a screen-reader label while loading, renders nothing when empty, and fills the URL on click.

home.first-run.why: #381: FirstRunGate (src/onboarding/FirstRunGate.tsx, mounted around App in main.tsx) reads first_time_onboarding_step from the settings table (onboarding_commands.rs, crates/openconductor-db onboarding.rs) and shows /first-run-onboarding on a fresh install with no repositories, as Conductor's Pya/Bxa do (evidence/screens/first-run-onboarding.md); Continue writes 999 and DONE and goes to '/'. Three slides with titles and descriptions, ArrowDown and Enter. By design: no Conductor account (always 'Continue'), placeholder media instead of Conductor's videos, no analytics. Covered by tests/e2e/first-run.e2e.mjs and firstRun.test.ts.

home.persist.why: In the desktop app the sidebar and Home load repos and workspaces from conductor.db through db_list_repos / db_list_workspaces (persistence_commands.rs); localStorage keeps only UI prefs; add, clone, create, rename and archive write rows. Gaps: remote_url is never written, and Quick start / palette placeholder workspaces are not saved.

create.entry.why: Cmd+N, the sidebar Create row, each repo's + and New workspace menu item (Sidebar.tsx), and the palette action all open CreateWorkspaceDialog.

create.page.why: Create is still a modal (CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx) with a prompt box, create-from picker, repo and base-branch selects and a name field, not the reference's full-screen composer with tabs; agent, model and effort come from Settings › Default models with no picker in the composer. Re-read on 0f82f19: unchanged. PR #388 (Conductor's composer and the full-screen /create page behind Settings > Experimental > New workspace page) is open, not merged, so it is not scored.

create.from-ref.why: CreateFromPicker.tsx PR, branch and issue tabs; PRs and GitHub issues come from the registered pr_list_open and gh_issue_list_open (#203), a PR passes prNumber so fork heads are fetched (#197), an issue seeds the first message. Not covered: Linear issues, lookup beyond the 100 loaded items.

create.base-branch.why: Base-branch select fed by list_branches, defaulting to the repo default branch, passed to create_workspace and written to conductor.db as initialization_parent_branch / intended_target_branch (#224).

create.branch-picker.why: Branch tab of CreateFromPicker.tsx with search, loading, empty and error states over list_branches (createFrom.ts statusLine, dedupeBranches).

create.worktree.why: #375 adds the conductor_root_path setting: WorkspaceManager::with_root and workspaces_dir put workspaces under <root>/workspaces/<repo slug> (archive records and default clones under the same root). Settings > Advanced RootPathRow (Browse, 'Change root path?', change_conductor_root, which forgets repos, saves and restarts) and Repo settings > Misc 'Workspaces path' (repo_workspaces_path) make it reachable. #379 brings the -v1/-v2 name bump (naming::bump). Deliberate difference: with no setting the root is the app data directory, not Conductor's ~/conductor.

create.branch-prefix.why: Settings › Git (GitPage.tsx) edits branch_prefix_type / branch_prefix_custom; App.tsx reads the registered branch_prefix_settings (with the gh username) each time the dialog opens and the dialog applies resolveBranchPrefix.

create.placeholder-name.why: City placeholder with rarity badge (naming.ts); after the first message renameAfterFirstMessage renames workspace and branch via rename_workspace_branch. No rename-on-branch toggle (always on), and placeholder_branch_name is not stored.

create.validation.why: buildCreateRequest (createFlow.ts) validates name, repo, base branch and source with per-field errors; create_workspace rejects invalid branch names (git.rs).

create.copy-files.why: The create path resolves .worktreeinclude / include globs / .env* through files_to_copy.rs and copies them into each new worktree; initialization_files_copied is not written to conductor.db.

create.setup-script.why: After create_workspace, CreateWorkspaceDialog's startSetupScript calls scripts_config then setup_script_start, registered in lib.rs over the now-linked oc-scripts ScriptService; the workspace shows running-setup and the Setup tab (ScriptsPanel.tsx) shows output and the log path.

create.initializing.why: #327 adds a pendingLaunches store (src/workspace/pendingLaunches.ts, a port of Conductor's Y5e with the 120 s expiry): CreateWorkspaceDialog adds a launch on submit and removes it when the create finishes or fails, and RepoWorkspaceList/PendingWorkspaceRow (Sidebar.tsx) show an inert 'Untitled' row with a spinner ('Creating workspace...'), also in a collapsed group. Still no initializing workspace view and no initialization log, and the loader is a CSS spinner rather than Conductor's sprite.

create.failure.why: A failed create shows the backend error in the dialog and on_create_failed drops the pending row; a failed setup raises a toast pointing to the Setup log (setupWatch.ts); startup runs delete_incomplete -> delete_if_initializing (#224). No initialization_log_path for worktree failures.

create.in-section.why: #419 on d353535: a section's header menu starts with 'Create workspace' (Conductor's oBi @10,005,110), which opens the create dialog with that section; its Create button reads 'Create in <name>'. Opened without a section while sections exist, Create splits with a 'Create in section' menu listing every section (iQo @9,711,015). After the create the workspace is assigned to the section and unpinned (assignSection, persisted with the sections layout); a section deleted meanwhile keeps the workspace and warns with Conductor's SECTION_ASSIGN_FAILED text (src/workspace/createInSection.ts, tested).

create.first-message.why: seedTranscript queues the first message and ChatPanel sends it with sendReason over the registered reason_open_chat / reason_prompt (#194), starting the workspace's first agent session; it also drives the rename. The draft's model and effort are not passed to the chat.

create.number.why: #305 (9883bb3; its squash title says evidence, but it carries the code; the earlier 'evidence only' reading was wrong): begin_workspace numbers the initializing row with workspaces::next_number (MAX(number)+1 across repositories, crates/openconductor-db/src/workspaces.rs) and finish_workspace keeps it, or assigns one if the row was a leftover; create_workspace returns it (CreatedWorkspaceDto.number), and db_list_workspaces/reposFromDb carry Workspace.number, which the Home list matches as W-<n>. Archived rows keep their number, so none is reused. Conductor's server assigns the number instead (evidence/create-workspace/README.md); a local rule is the only option without it. Covered by persistence test each_new_workspace_gets_the_next_number_across_repositories. Showing W-<n> on rows is sidebar.ws-numbers, scored there.

create.autostart-run.why: Settings > Experimental 'Auto-run after setup' (ExperimentalPage.tsx) calls auto_run_after_setup_get/_set (registered in lib.rs), which write [scripts] auto_run_after_setup to the user settings.toml the oc-scripts loader reads (config/user.rs, #324); after a completed setup ScriptService::after_setup -> should_auto_run starts the default run script, a failed setup never auto-runs, and a repo layer still overrides (crates/scripts service tests). User scope, default off, as in Conductor 0.87.6 (REA IRt/fQe, evidence/run-scripts/NOTES.md). Not run end to end in the packaged app.

sidebar.top-bar.why: The Sidebar.tsx top bar has a toggle button (toggleSidebar) and back/forward arrows driven by useNavHistory (src/state/useNavHistory.ts, history.ts), disabled at the ends; nav.back/nav.forward use the same handlers. REA capture matches the reference layout.

sidebar.computer-switcher.why: #410 on 9930339: AccountMenu.tsx replaces the static row: an 'Account menu' button with the initial avatar, "<name>'s Mac" (or 'My Mac') from the registered local_account (macOS full name or git user.name) and a chevron, opening a 260 px menu with the git email heading and Settings, as Conductor's zna @9,957,506 does for a single personal organization. Conductor's organization list, Create organization, Upgrade to Pro and Log out need its cloud account and are left out; Conductor also hides the row with nobody signed in, while ours always shows the local user.

sidebar.primary-nav.why: Home, Create (opens the create dialog) and Search (opens the command palette) rows with shortcut hints above the workspace list (Sidebar.tsx); REA capture matches the reference.

sidebar.workspaces-group.why: Sentence-case 'My workspaces' section header with a hover menu replaces the uppercase Repositories header (Sidebar.tsx). Its collapsed state is not persisted.

sidebar.footer-actions.why: Footer HelpMenu (src/components/HelpMenu.tsx, helpMenuItems.ts) and a Settings icon button that opens settings; REA capture matches the reference footer.

sidebar.colors.why: Measured on REA captures at 1440x900 on 0e2531b: sidebar edge at x=255 in both, sidebar fill #1c1817 dark / #fcfcfb light and main #141110 / #ffffff identical to the reference. REA compare-web-screenshots (t=24): 0.6-0.9% of sidebar pixels differ (was 3.1-5.4%), from text and data only.

home.colors.why: Measured on REA captures on 0e2531b after #269: main background (#141110 dark, #ffffff light), entry-card fill (#211e1c / #fafaf9) and card border (#373433 / #eae8e6) are pixel-identical to the reference at the sampled points.
